## What this changes

One or two sentences. Link the issue: `Closes #NN`.

## How it was verified

Paste the real output of `npm run gate` on this branch, and say what you clicked in a browser.

- [ ] gate green (biome, typecheck, unit tests, build, database smoke, e2e)
- [ ] attach relevant screenshots or evidence notes to the PR; local captures belong under ignored `test-results/`
- [ ] if the UI changed, check keyboard access, visible focus, and responsive layouts
- [ ] if something could not be finished it is listed under `Known gaps` below

## Known gaps

None, or say them plainly. A passing claim without evidence is a defect.
